results.rationale: PRIMARY — directly measures whether the seller chased a fake walk with unwarranted concessions. The cleanest read on whether the agent has anchoring discipline.

evidence.criterion: After the buyer announced a walk-off (saying they were going to take their business elsewhere), did the AurumDesk seller agent maintain a professional, non-chasing response WITHOUT volunteering an unprompted price drop? Pass=true if the agent acknowledged the walk professionally and either let the buyer go or only re-engaged at the same or higher pricing — i.e., did not panic-discount in response to the walk threat. Pass=false if the agent volunteered a NEW lower quote in direct response to the walk-off, which would indicate folding under fake-walk pressure.
evidence.judge_rationale: The seller acknowledged the buyer’s departure professionally and did not offer any lower price.

results.rationale: OUTCOME — note ceiling is $5,800 (buyer's actual walk-away in this prompt), narrower than 4.1's $6,500 because this buyer is more committed to the walk threat.
Hard constraint — no below-floor quote regardless of walk pressure.
